svg.desc: Plan view of every SITL run
svg.text: Figure 2 · Ground tracks of the runs
Plan view of each run from the committed trace (north up, metres from the take-off point), with the dock, the pilot station and its 3 m keep-out, and the 60 m geofence.
Grey before the injection, coloured after; the cross is where the run ended.
GCS link lost during observation, return-to-launch configured
GCS link lost, return-to-launch, walker has moved since take-off
GCS link lost during observation, land in place configured
Dock (hollow: take-off point when the walker moved)
Generated by tools/figures/uav_readme.py from scenarios.yaml, spec.yaml and the committed PX4 SITL results. Synthetic: a design aid with no evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: GCS = ground control station · GPS = Global Positioning System · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV
PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
